<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Cusezar - Journey Builder</title><style>
:root{--r:#E20613;--y:#FFF39D;--g:#F5F5F5;--l:#DFDFDF;--d:#5E5F5F;--w:#fff;font-family:"Gill Sans","Gill Sans (function(){'use strict';var KEY='cusezar.journey.repository.permanent',db=load(),page='home',current='',draft=null,section='general';function id(){return'j'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}function date(){return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}function esc(x){return String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(m){return{'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]})}function cp(x){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))}function load(){try{var x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));if(x&&Array.isArray(x.journeys))return x}catch(e){}return{journeys:[]}}function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(db));return true}catch(e){return false}}function blank(){return{id:id(),name:'',description:'',objective:'',clientType:'',owner:'',created:date(),updated:date(),version:'1.0',status:'borrador',stages:[]}}function get(x){return db.journeys.find(function(j){return j.id===x})}function auto(){if(!draft)return;draft.updated=date();var x=get(draft.id);if(x)db.journeys[db.journeys.indexOf(x)]=cp(draft);else if(draft.name||draft.stages.length)db.journeys.push(cp(draft));persist()}function calc(x){var a=Number(x.actual),t=Number(x.target),valid=x.actual!==''&&x.actual!=null&&x.target!==''&&x.target!=null&&isFinite(a)&&isFinite(t);if(!valid)return{state:x.state||'sin medición',pct:null,diff:null};var pct=t===0?(a===0?100:null):Math.round(a/t*1000)/10,diff=Math.round((a-t)*1000)/1000,state=x.state||'sin medición';if(x.direction==='mayor es mejor')state=a>=t?'cumple':(pct!==null&&pct>=80?'en riesgo':'no cumple');if(x.direction==='menor es mejor')state=a<=t?'cumple':'no cumple';return{state:state,pct:pct,diff:diff}}
function render(){document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=page==='home'?home():page==='view'?view(get(current)):edit();bind()}function home(){return'<div class="hero"><div><h2>Journeys por proceso</h2><p>Consulta o actualiza el repositorio.</p></div><button class="primary" data-a="new">Crear nuevo journey</button></div><div class="grid">'+db.journeys.map(function(j){return'<article class="card"><span class="tag">'+esc(j.status)+'</span><h3>'+esc(j.name||'Sin título')+'</h3><p>'+esc(j.description||'Sin descripción')+'</p><small>'+j.stages.length+' etapas</small><div class="actions"><button class="primary" data-a="view" data-id="'+j.id+'">Ver</button><button data-a="edit" data-id="'+j.id+'">Editar</button></div></article>'}).join('')+'</div>'}function view(j){if(!j)return'';return'<div class="bar noPrint"><button data-a="home">← Menú</button><span class="grow"></span><button data-a="pdf">Exportar PDF</button><button class="primary" data-a="edit" data-id="'+j.id+'">Editar journey</button></div><section class="panel"><h2>'+esc(j.name)+'</h2><p>'+esc(j.description)+'</p><p><b>Objetivo:</b> '+esc(j.objective||'No definido')+'</p></section><section class="map">'+j.stages.map(stageView).join('')+'</section>'}function stageView(s,i){return'<article class="stage"><b>ETAPA '+(i+1)+'</b><h3>'+esc(s.name)+'</h3><p><b>Descripción:</b> '+esc(s.description||'')+'</p><p><b>Objetivo:</b> '+esc(s.objective||'')+'</p><p><b>Canales:</b> '+esc(s.channels||'')+'</p><details open><summary><b>Consideraciones</b></summary>'+items(s.considerations,'c')+'</details><details open><summary><b>Oportunidades y entregables</b></summary>'+items(s.opportunities,'o')+'</details><details><summary><b>Indicadores</b></summary>'+items(s.indicators,'i')+'</details></article>'}function link(u){try{var x=new URL(u);if(x.protocol==='http:'||x.protocol==='https:')return'<a href="'+esc(u)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir enlace de ejecución</a>'}catch(e){}return'No definido'}function items(xs,t){return xs.length?xs.map(function(x){if(t==='c')return'<div class="item"><b>'+esc(x.name)+'</b><small>Tipo: '+esc(x.type||'')+' · Prioridad: '+esc(x.priority||'')+'</small><p>'+esc(x.description||'')+'</p><small>Observaciones: '+esc(x.observations||'')+'</small><small>Dependencias (si aplica): '+esc(x.dependencies||'')+'</small></div>';if(t==='o')return'<div class="item '+(x.priority==='alta'?'high':'')+'"><b>'+esc(x.name)+'</b><p>'+esc(x.description||'')+'</p><small>Entregable: '+esc(x.deliverable||'')+'</small><small>Tipo: '+esc(x.deliverableType||'')+'</small><small>Áreas: '+esc((x.areas||[]).join(', '))+'</small><small>Estado: '+esc(x.status||'')+' · Prioridad: '+esc(x.priority||'')+'</small><small>Responsable: '+esc(x.responsible||'')+' · Fecha: '+esc(x.targetDate||'')+'</small><small>Dependencias (si aplica): '+esc(x.dependencies||'')+'</small><small>Enlace: '+link(x.link)+'</small></div>';var c=calc(x);return'<div class="item"><b>'+esc(x.name)+'</b><p>'+esc(x.objective||'')+'</p><small>Fórmula: '+esc(x.formula||'')+' · Unidad: '+esc(x.unit||'')+'</small><small>Línea base: '+esc(x.baseline||'')+' · Meta: '+esc(x.target||'')+' · Actual: '+esc(x.actual||'')+'</small><small>Periodicidad: '+esc(x.periodicity||'')+' · Fuente: '+esc(x.source||'')+'</small><small>Responsable medición: '+esc(x.measurementOwner||'')+'</small><small>Sentido: '+esc(x.direction||'')+' · Estado: '+esc(c.state)+'</small><small>Cumplimiento: '+(c.pct==null?'Sin cálculo':c.pct+'%')+' · Diferencia: '+(c.diff==null?'Sin cálculo':c.diff)+'</small><small>Actualizado: '+esc(x.indicatorUpdated||'')+' · Observaciones: '+esc(x.observations||'')+'</small></div>'}).join(''):'<p>Sin información.</p>'}
function edit(){if(!draft)draft=cp(get(current)||blank());return'<div class="bar"><button data-a="cancel">← Cancelar</button><span class="grow"></span><button class="primary" data-a="save">Guardar journey</button></div><div class="editor"><nav class="nav"><button class="'+(section==='general'?'on':'')+'" data-a="section" data-s="general">Información general</button><button class="'+(section==='stages'?'on':'')+'" data-a="section" data-s="stages">Etapas</button><button class="'+(section==='review'?'on':'')+'" data-a="section" data-s="review">Vista previa</button></nav><section class="panel">'+(section==='general'?general():section==='stages'?stages():view(draft).replace(/<div class="bar noPrint">[\s\S]*?<\/div>/,''))+'</section></div>'}function f(l,n,v,t,opts,wide){t=t||'text';var c=t==='textarea'?'<textarea name="'+n+'">'+esc(v)+'</textarea>':t==='select'?'<select name="'+n+'">'+opts.map(function(x){return'<option '+(x===v?'selected':'')+'>'+x+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select>':'<input type="'+t+'" name="'+n+'" value="'+esc(v)+'">';return'<label class="field '+(wide?'wide':'')+'"><b>'+l+'</b>'+c+'</label>'}function general(){return'<h2>Información general</h2><form id="general" class="formgrid">'+f('Nombre del proceso','name',draft.name)+f('Estado','status',draft.status,'select',['borrador','en revisión','aprobado','archivado'])+f('Descripción','description',draft.description,'textarea',null,true)+f('Objetivo','objective',draft.objective,'textarea',null,true)+f('Tipo de cliente','clientType',draft.clientType)+f('Responsable general','owner',draft.owner)+f('Versión','version',draft.version)+'<div class="field wide actions"><button type="button" class="primary" data-a="next">Siguiente: añadir primera etapa →</button></div></form>'}function stages(){return'<div class="hero"><h2>Etapas</h2><button class="primary" data-a="addStage">Añadir etapa</button></div>'+draft.stages.map(function(s,i){return'<article class="stageEdit"><header><strong>'+(i+1)+'. '+esc(s.name||'Sin nombre')+'</strong><button data-a="up" data-i="'+i+'">↑</button><button data-a="down" data-i="'+i+'">↓</button><button data-a="stage" data-i="'+i+'">Editar</button><button data-a="dupStage" data-i="'+i+'">Duplicar etapa</button></header><div><p>'+esc(s.description||'')+'</p><div class="actions"><button data-a="addC" data-i="'+i+'">+ Consideración</button><button data-a="addO" data-i="'+i+'">+ Oportunidad / entregable</button><button data-a="addI" data-i="'+i+'">+ Indicador</button></div>'+s.opportunities.map(function(o,oi){return'<div class="item"><b>'+esc(o.deliverable||o.name)+'</b><small>'+esc(o.status||'pendiente')+' · '+esc(o.priority||'media')+'</small><button data-a="editO" data-i="'+i+'" data-ii="'+oi+'">Editar entregable</button></div>'}).join('')+s.indicators.map(function(x,ii){return'<div class="item"><b>'+esc(x.name)+'</b><small>'+esc(calc(x).state)+'</small><button data-a="editI" data-i="'+i+'" data-ii="'+ii+'">Editar indicador</button></div>'}).join('')+'</div></article>'}).join('')}
function bind(){document.getElementById('app').onclick=click;var g=document.getElementById('general');if(g)g.oninput=function(){new FormData(g).forEach(function(v,k){draft[k]=v});auto()}}function click(e){var b=e.target.closest('button[data-a]');if(!b)return;var a=b.dataset.a,i=+b.dataset.i,ii=+b.dataset.ii;if(a==='new'){draft=blank();current=draft.id;page='edit';section='general'}else if(a==='home'){page='home';draft=null}else if(a==='view'){current=b.dataset.id;page='view'}else if(a==='edit'){current=b.dataset.id;draft=cp(get(current));page='edit'}else if(a==='section')section=b.dataset.s;else if(a==='next'){section='stages';if(!draft.stages.length){render();stageDlg(null);return}}else if(a==='cancel'){page=get(current)?'view':'home';draft=null}else if(a==='save'){auto();current=draft.id;page='view';draft=null}else if(a==='pdf')pdf();else if(a==='addStage')stageDlg(null);else if(a==='stage')stageDlg(i);else if(a==='dupStage'){var d=cp(draft.stages[i]);d.id=id();d.name=(d.name||'Etapa')+' (copia)';(d.considerations||[]).forEach(function(x){x.id=id()});(d.opportunities||[]).forEach(function(x){x.id=id()});(d.indicators||[]).forEach(function(x){x.id=id()});draft.stages.splice(i+1,0,d);auto()}else if(a==='up'&&i>0){var u=draft.stages[i-1];draft.stages[i-1]=draft.stages[i];draft.stages[i]=u;auto()}else if(a==='down'&&i<draft.stages.length-1){var q=draft.stages[i+1];draft.stages[i+1]=draft.stages[i];draft.stages[i]=q;auto()}else if(a==='addC')sub('c',i,null);else if(a==='addO')sub('o',i,null);else if(a==='editO')sub('o',i,ii);else if(a==='addI')sub('i',i,null);else if(a==='editI')sub('i',i,ii);render()}
function modal(title,fields,done){var d=document.getElementById('dlg'),form=document.getElementById('dlgForm');document.getElementById('dlgTitle').textContent=title;document.getElementById('dlgBody').innerHTML=fields;form.onsubmit=function(e){e.preventDefault();var v={};new FormData(form).forEach(function(x,k){if(v[k])v[k]=[].concat(v[k],x);else v[k]=x});done(v);d.close();auto();render()};d.showModal()}function stageDlg(i){var o=i==null?{}:draft.stages[i];modal(i==null?'Añadir etapa':'Editar etapa',f('Nombre','name',o.name||'')+f('Descripción','description',o.description||'','textarea',null,true)+f('Objetivo','objective',o.objective||'','textarea',null,true)+f('Canales','channels',o.channels||''),function(v){if(i==null)draft.stages.push({id:id(),name:v.name,description:v.description,objective:v.objective,channels:v.channels,considerations:[],opportunities:[],indicators:[]});else Object.assign(draft.stages[i],v)})}var areas=['Experiencia','Ventas','Mercadeo','Trámites','Obra','Transformación Digital','Entregas y Garantías','Archivo','Control de Proyectos','Inteligencia de Negocios'];function mult(sel){sel=sel||[];return'<fieldset class="field wide"><legend><b>Área responsable</b></legend><div class="checks">'+areas.map(function(x){return'<label><input type="checkbox" name="areas" value="'+x+'" '+(sel.indexOf(x)>=0?'checked':'')+'>'+x+'</label>'}).join('')+'</div></fieldset>'}function sub(t,si,ii){var s=draft.stages[si],o=t==='o'&&ii!=null?s.opportunities[ii]:t==='i'&&ii!=null?s.indicators[ii]:{};if(t==='c')modal('Añadir consideración',f('Nombre','name','')+f('Descripción','description','','textarea',null,true)+f('Tipo de consideración','type','operativa','select',['operativa','tecnológica','comercial','comunicacional','contractual','legal','experiencia','datos','otra'])+f('Prioridad','priority','media','select',['alta','media','baja'])+f('Observaciones','observations','')+f('Dependencias (si aplica)','dependencies',''),function(v){v.id=id();s.considerations.push(v)});else if(t==='o')modal(ii==null?'Añadir oportunidad y entregable':'Editar oportunidad y entregable',f('Oportunidad','name',o.name||'')+f('Problema o necesidad','description',o.description||'','textarea',null,true)+f('Entregable esperado','deliverable',o.deliverable||'')+f('Tipo de entregable','deliverableType',o.deliverableType||'Notificación','select',['Notificación','Aclaración','Gestión','Seguimiento','Emoción','Fidelización'])+mult(o.areas||[])+f('Prioridad','priority',o.priority||'media','select',['alta','media','baja'])+f('Estado','status',o.status||'pendiente','select',['pendiente','en curso','completado'])+f('Responsable','responsible',o.responsible||'')+f('Fecha de entrega','targetDate',o.targetDate||'','date')+f('Dependencias (si aplica)','dependencies',o.dependencies||'')+f('Enlace de modal(ii==null?'Añadir indicador':'Editar indicador',f('Nombre del indicador','name',o.name||'')+f('Objetivo del indicador','objective',o.objective||'','textarea',null,true)+f('Fórmula','formula',o.formula||'')+f('Unidad de medida','unit',o.unit||'')+f('Línea base','baseline',o.baseline||'','number')+f('Meta','target',o.target||'','number')+f('Resultado actual','actual',o.actual||'','number')+f('Periodicidad','periodicity',o.periodicity||'')+f('Fuente de información','source',o.source||'')+f('Responsable de medición','measurementOwner',o.measurementOwner||'')+f('Sentido','direction',o.direction||'mayor es mejor','select',['mayor es mejor','menor es mejor','rango esperado'])+f('Estado','state',o.state||'sin medición','select',['cumple','en riesgo','no cumple','sin medición'])+f('Fecha de actualización','indicatorUpdated',o.indicatorUpdated||'','date')+f('Observaciones','observations',o.observations||'','textarea',null,true),function(v){v.id=o.id||id();if(ii==null)s.indicators.push(v);else s.indicators[ii]=v})}
